blocks.text: Drug discovery kisi bimari ki nayi dawa dhoondne ka pehla marhala hai. Jadeed (modern) dawaen in marhalon (stages) se guzar kar dhoondi jati hain:
Scientists koi khaas molecule, jaise protein ya enzyme, pehchante hain jo bimari paida karne mein shamil ho. Yeh target is liye chuna jata hai ke dawa is par asar kar ke bimari ka ilaaj kar sake.

Researchers tasdeeq (confirm) karte hain ke pehchana gaya target waqai bimari mein ahem kirdar ada karta hai. Experiments kiye jate hain taa ke yaqeen ho ke is target par asar karne se ilaaj wala (therapeutic) asar mil sakta hai.

Scientists hazaron qudrati ya synthetic compounds ko jaanchte (screen karte) hain taa ke woh maadde milen jo target molecule ke saath achhi tarah amal kar sakein. In umeed afza maaddon ko lead compounds kehte hain.
Lead compounds mein tabdeeliyan ki jati hain taa ke un ka asar barhe, zehreela pan (toxicity) kam ho aur un ki dawa jaisi khasiyatein (drug-like properties) behtar hon.

blocks.prompt: Drug discovery ka pehla qadam kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Target identification: bimari mein shamil woh molecule (jaise protein ya enzyme) dhoondna jis par dawa asar kar sake.

items: Chaar marhale: target identification, target validation, lead compound identification, lead optimization.
